description: Source code for the Purchase Receipt doctype in ERPNext, including class definition, validation, stock and accounting logic, and related functions.

classes.name: PurchaseReceipt
classes.description: Main class representing the Purchase Receipt doctype, handling validation, submission, cancellation, and accounting logic.

methods.name: update_billed_amount_based_on_po
methods.description: Updates billed amounts on Purchase Receipt Items based on linked Purchase Invoice and Purchase Receipt data.

methods.name: update_billing_percentage
methods.description: Calculates and updates the billing percentage for a Purchase Receipt based on received and invoiced quantities.

methods.name: make_purchase_invoice
methods.description: Creates a Purchase Invoice from a Purchase Receipt, mapping relevant fields and quantities.

methods.name: get_invoiced_qty_map
methods.description: Returns a mapping of Purchase Receipt details to invoiced quantities.

methods.name: get_returned_qty_map
methods.description: Returns a mapping of Purchase Receipt items to returned quantities.

methods.name: make_purchase_return
methods.description: Creates a Purchase Return document from a Purchase Receipt.

methods.name: update_purchase_receipt_status
methods.description: Updates the status of a Purchase Receipt.

methods.name: make_stock_entry
methods.description: Creates a Stock Entry document for transferring stock based on the Purchase Receipt.

methods.name: make_inter_company_delivery_note
methods.description: Creates an inter-company delivery note for the Purchase Receipt.

methods.name: get_item_account_wise_additional_cost
methods.description: Retrieves additional landed cost amounts grouped by item and account for a given purchase document.
